title: privacy-attacks
summary: A research codebase implementing membership inference attacks (MIA) against synthetic-data generators, training victim models with multiple tabular synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, TableGAN, OCTGAN, and an identity baseline). It vendors in-tree CTGAN and TVAE synthesizer implementations under mia/synthesizers/ as the attack targets that are trained and queried.
evidence: MIA/mia/synthesizers/__init__.py:1-5 imports CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from local mia.synthesizers modules, invoked via train_victim_model.py's run(Synthesizer, ...)
needs: README truncated; cannot confirm whether vendored ctgan/tvae code is modified from upstream or an unmodified copy, and no authors are listed in available evidence.
